findings.issue: Filtering --list by the literal category 未分類 bypasses JSON membership and includes videos with no such category, unlike search and Dashboard. The unfiltered display group can remain without treating it as an actual category.

A cache row is treated as a usable vector before validation. If every matched vector is corrupt, semantic search may call the embedder and return an unexplained empty result instead of falling back or failing in strict mode. A non-BLOB vector also crashes the shared decoder used by audit and embedding plans.

needs-human (pre-existing): retrieval.query_embedding is true on a category miss even when the embedder is never called. Its public meaning is undocumented: requested semantic mode and actual embedding invocation require different values, so changing the API requires an explicit contract decision.

summary: Fixed inconsistent 未分類 filtering and invalid-vector fallback, including the shared decoder used by audit and embedding plans. needs-human: the pre-existing retrieval.query_embedding flag remains true when no embedding call occurs; clarify whether it records the requested mode or an actual call before changing the API.
